MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 60

7. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 15
   C. 30
   D. 44

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

10. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 24.5
   C. 49
   D. 7

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

14. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

15. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
